内核模块提取自HyperOS 4.0.30  
用作当AERA_LOAD_VENDOR_MODULES从vendor分区加载LKM失败时的回退  
正常情况下当前目录的内核模块是不会被使用的

LKM extracted from HyperOS 4.0.30  
Used as a fallback when AERA_LOAD_VENDORMODULES fails to load modules from the vendor partition  
Under normal circumstances, the LKM in the current directory will not be used
